info.title: SkillAlign
info.description: SkillAlign — Enterprise Talent Intelligence & Recruitment Automation Platform. Powering data-driven hiring decisions at scale.

post.summary: Candidate self-registration
post.description: Allows public users to register as a Candidate. Privileged roles cannot be created here.

post.summary: User login
post.description: Authenticates credentials and returns a signed JWT access token.

get.summary: Get current user profile
get.description: Returns the profile information and role of the currently authenticated user.

put.description: Updates the profile information (name, phone, email) of the authenticated user.

post.summary: Request OTP for phone login
post.description: Sends a 6-digit OTP to the provided phone number. Valid for 5 minutes.

post.summary: Verify OTP and login
post.description: Verifies the OTP. If the phone is new, creates a Candidate account. Returns a JWT.

post.summary: Resend OTP
post.description: Resends OTP to the phone number. Subject to cooldown period.

post.summary: Request password reset
post.description: Generates a cryptographically secure reset token, saves its SHA-256 hash in DB, and dispatches a reset email.

post.summary: Reset password with token
post.description: Verifies the token hash, enforces token expiration, and updates the user's password.

post.summary: User logout
post.description: Revokes and blacklists current JWT access token.

post.summary: Refresh access token
post.description: Issues a fresh JWT access token and revokes the existing one.

post.summary: Create HR or Recruiter user
post.description: Admin creates a new privileged account (HR or Recruiter). Role must be 2 (HR) or 3 (Recruiter).

post.summary: Upload Candidate Resume (PDF, DOCX, TXT) — Async Processing
post.description: Stores the original resume to S3 immediately, then queues async processing (text extraction, parsing, skill sync, auto-matching). Returns a task_id for status polling via GET /{id}/resume/status. Processing typically completes within 5-30 seconds depending on file size.

get.summary: Get Pre-signed S3 URL to View/Download Original Resume
get.description:
Generates a secure, temporary pre-signed URL with ExpiresIn=300 (5 minutes).
Accessible by Candidate (own profile), Recruiter, HR, and Admin.

delete.summary: Delete Candidate Resume & Extracted Documents from Storage
delete.description:
Deletes original file and extracted TXT from storage and clears database columns.
Accessible only by the Candidate owner or Admin.

get.summary: Get Resume Processing Status
get.description: Poll this endpoint to check if async resume processing has completed.

get.summary: Get Extracted Plain Text (.txt) of Candidate Resume
get.description:
Returns the clean extracted plain text representation of the resume.
Accessible by Candidate (own profile), Recruiter, HR, and Admin.

get.summary: Get Structured Parsed Data (Skills, Experience, Education, Certifications)
get.description:
Returns structured parsed fields extracted deterministically from resume text.
Accessible by Candidate (own profile), Recruiter, HR, and Admin.

post.summary: Reparse Existing Resume Text with Enhanced Deterministic Extractor
post.description: Re-runs deterministic parsing on candidate's existing resume text and refreshes extracted structured data.

post.summary: Queue matching engine for a job (Recruiter/HR/Admin)
post.description: Queues an async background matching task. Returns immediately with task status. Normal matching is triggered automatically when HR publishes/updates a job or a candidate uploads a resume. Use this endpoint for manual re-evaluation. Recruiter can trigger re-matching for any active job.

post.summary: HM: Submit per-round feedback and GO/PASS/NO-GO decision
post.description:
HM submits per-round feedback with PASS/GO/NO_GO recommendation.
- PASS: Intermediate round passed, next round to be scheduled.
- GO: Final round approved, pipeline advances to COMPENSATION_DISCUSSION.
- NO_GO: Terminates the pipeline.

Candidate: Accept or reject offer (public, token-authenticated)
post.description: Candidate accepts or rejects an offer using the secure token.

post.summary: Recruiter: Submit offer to HM for approval
post.description:
Recruiter submits a DRAFT offer to the Hiring Manager for review.
Transitions: DRAFT → PENDING_HM_REVIEW.

post.summary: HM: Approve or request changes to an offer
post.description:
HM reviews a submitted offer and either approves or requests changes.
- APPROVE → HM_APPROVED (recruiter can now generate PDF)
- REQUEST_CHANGES → HM_CHANGES_REQUESTED (recruiter edits and resubmits)

post.summary: Recruiter: Generate official PDF offer letter
post.description:
Generate the official PDF offer letter for an HM-approved offer.
Requires workflow_state == HM_APPROVED.
Transitions: HM_APPROVED → OFFER_READY.

message.default: Resume and extracted documents deleted successfully

ResumeStatusResponse.title: ResumeStatusResponse
ResumeStatusResponse.description:
Resume processing status — used for async status polling.
processing_status values:
  not_uploaded  → no resume on file
  processing    → uploaded but not yet parsed (worker running)
  completed     → fully parsed, skills extracted, matching triggered
  failed        → processing encountered an error

message.title: Message
message.default: Resume uploaded successfully. Processing has been queued.

ResumeUploadResponse.title: ResumeUploadResponse
ResumeUploadResponse.description:
Async upload response — returned immediately after file is stored to S3.
Processing happens asynchronously via Celery.
Poll GET /{candidate_id}/resume/status to check completion.
